comparison.objective: Clip a pulse oximeter onto the correct finger while preserving hand pose.
comparison.physical_skill: Spring-jaw opening, finger insertion, bimanual stabilization and release.
comparison.success_condition: Correctly oriented, seated clip; hand not dragged; both grippers released and stable for 1 s. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests compliant clip placement on one articulated mechanism, not selective many-body passage through a sieve.
